name: J-Town Grab and Go
notes: None of the 4 photos name 'J-Town Grab and Go' directly; they show three separately-branded vendor menu posters (Ichiban Sando, Hako Sushi Box, and a milk tea/matcha/coffee stand). Photo 3 shows all three posters displayed together side-by-side on one shared shelf/wall, indicating this listing is a shared grab-and-go space housing all three vendors - treated as one combined menu rather than excluded as a mismatch. Sando/rice-bowl prices come from the clearer close-up poster (photo 4); the Sushi Box and Drinks posters (photos 2-3) show no prices at all, so those items are listed without a price. A large, mostly identical roll/box list was trimmed to a representative sample to avoid duplicating the full poster.
